item.text: [{"task_id":"b0c4d837","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    wall = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    liquid = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    height = max(1, min(grid.shape[0], int(round(params['geometry'][0]))))","    width = max(1, min(grid.shape[1], int(round(params['geometry'][1]))))","    inset = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    out = np.full((height, width), background, dtype=int)","    walls = np.argwhere(grid == wall)","    if len(walls) == 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(walls[:, 0]))","    bottom = int(np.max(walls[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(walls[:, 1])) + inset","    right = int(np.max(walls[:, 1]))","    interior = grid[top:bottom, left:right]","    count = int(np.count_nonzero(np.all(interior == background, axis=1)))","    for k in range(len(params['path'])):","        if k < count:","            row = int(round(params['path'][k][0]))","            col = int(round(params['path'][k][1]))","            if 0 <= row < height and 0 <= col < width:","                out[row, col] = liquid","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[3],"path":[9,2]},"params":{"colors":[0,5,8],"geometry":[3,3,1],"path":[[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[1,2],[2,2],[2,1],[2,0],[1,0],[1,1]]},"rationale":"Count empty rows inside the gray container above the liquid, then place that many blue cells along a clockwise spiral in a 3×3 output. The test has one empty row, producing [[8,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]]."}]
